patch_description: Revert the regressive RX pre-shift layer (which added 18 params and hurt the score), restoring the proven 72-param structure. Then enrich expressivity by splitting the two-qubit entangling motif into two distinct sweeps with separate shared parameters: a clockwise endpoint->mid sweep and a counter-clockwise mid->endpoint sweep around the ring. This adds genuine bidirectional information flow on the outer ring (addressing the underfitting seen in the prior best where train accuracy lagged validation) while keeping parameter count modest. The decode RY layer stays orbit-shared (D4 symmetry) since it was the key working ingredient.
